privileged_info_for_vlm: The SDS archive is located at /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive. The output must be a CSV at /home/ga/reports/waveform_manifest.csv. Required headers are exactly: StreamID,StartTime,EndTime,SampleRate. The data concerns the 2024 Noto earthquake; timestamps must be in ISO-like format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) and reflect actual file boundaries, not just the event time.
